kāyalahutā.p: [Kāya+lahutā] (thī) CL=7 As the state of lightness of the sum of three physical bodies such as Vedanā. The lightness of the physical body.
a: ကာယလဟုတာ(ထီ)

F: Kāyalahutā，﹐【阴】心轻快性，去除心所（cetasika）的沉重（garubhāva）。
B:
kāyalahutā： kāyalahutā（thī）
ကာယလဟုတာ（ထီ）
[kāya+lahutā]
[ကာယ+လဟုတာ]
K:
kāyalahutā：ကာယလဟုတာ （ထီ）
[ကာယ+လဟုတာ]
ဝေဒနာစသော ခန္ဓာ-၃-ပါးအပေါင်း၏ ပေါ့သည်၏အဖြစ်၊ ကိုယ်၏ပေါ့ပါးခြင်း။
R:
kāyalahutā：ကာယ-လဟုတာ （ဣ）
ကိုယ်၏ ပေါ့ပါးသည်၏အဖြစ်။
CPD: kāya-lahutā, f., lightness of the body; ~ā, Dhs 1 (9, 18 ) (kāyassa lahubhāvo, As 130, 16 = Vism 465, 25 ); Dhs 337 qu. lt-a l 101, 2 = Abhidh-s 6, 17 (Abhidh-s-mhṭ 85, 14 ); yā … + saṅkhārakkhandhassa lahutā + … ayaṃ ~ā, Dhs 42; — ifc. citta ‑°.

kāyālasiya.p: [Kāya+ālasiya] (na) CL=8 The laziness of the body; Dizziness.

B:
kāyālasiya： kāyālasiya（na）
ကာယာလသိယ（န）
[kāya+ālasiya]
[ကာယ+အာလသိယ]
K:
kāyālasiya：ကာယာလသိယ （န）
[ကာယ+အာလသိယ]
ကိုယ်၏ပျင်းရိခြင်း၊ ကိုယ်ထိုင်းမှိုင်းခြင်း။
CPD: kāyâlasiya, n., bodily laziness; kāyaduṭṭhullaṃ kāya­daratho ~aṃ, Ps lV 208, 12 ; tandi nāma ~aṃ, lt-a ll 180, 13 ; ~assa middhassa, l 106, 18 ; anasanan ti … ~aṃ, Sv 855, 23 ; pacalāyikañ ca ~añ ca cittâlasiyañ ca, Pj ll 567, 21 ≠ Nidd-a l 432, 28 ; — °‑ tā, f., abstr. ; tandī nāma ~ā, Sv 780, 4 = Ps l 283, 24 = Vibh-a 272, 13 ; ālassânuyogo ti ~āya yutta­ppayuttā, Sv 945, 7 (Sv-pṭ lll 169, 1 ); — ~‑ paṭi­pas­sad­dhi, f., subsidence from bodily laziness; ~i, Ps lll 145, 13 ; — °‑ bhāva, m., abstr. ; kāyaduṭṭhullan ti ~o, Ps lV 202, 19 ; — °‑ lakkhaṇa, mfn., characterized by bodily laziness; ~aṃ middhaṃ, Th-a lll 30, 31 ; — °‑ vimocana, n., doing away with bodily lazi­ness; bhuttapātarāse °(´)‑at­thāya abbho­kāse caṅkamante, Dhp-a ll 214, 14 = Ud-a 86, 8 ; — °‑ virahita, mfn., free from bodily laziness; atandito nittan­dī ~o, Sv 893, 6 (kāyâlasivigamanena, Sv-pṭ lll 97, 10 ).
